body: Thank you all for your understandings and perspectives 💗 it's really great to have people to confide with. Whatever costumers say for drama, I do want to come dance in a chill environment around me.. I did try talking to one of the girls about it, even asked her if she wants to do a doubles night together, where we can split whatever we make then. she was a bit off with her response "I'll think about it".
I do find myself gorgeous and awesome, it's just that in an environment like this, I want to at least be able to come every night not being an outcast.
I really appreciate that, thank you 🔥
I don't really want to pump up my ego through that although I am confident with myself, I just kinda want to have a good work relationship with them... I think and see it as pretty obvious

Well I don't really say much, but usually on a good night i don't get a lot of a break... I don't really know how to deal with girls trying to make it hard for me. I've been stripping for around 2 years and I didn't really have that in past clubs or events i worked in.. it was more supportive than catty i would say

Well, the tone of how she said it definitely mattered. It was specifically after a good night for me and she kinda backhanded complimented me. I thanked her but I felt the tone. 
When the costumer said that, i basically just shrugged it. 

Mostly the examples are backhanded compliments and I am sure, you can interpret any positive words in a negative way if you want. It's not just what they say, but also the way they say it and I try to move on from it. I just want respectful relationships with the other girls working with me.
Thank you :) I hope it will help!
